Arrr, a magnificent challenge, me hearty\! An art-only poster showin' the grand similarities betwixt Earth, the human body, and celestial bodies – all without a single written word inside the frame\! And then, a second poster, a key, to unlock its mysteries. A grand plan, that be\!  
So, for our first poster, the art-only piece, I'll conjure forth an image that weaves together these grand elements, showin' their shared patterns and forms. Think of the swirling galaxies, the veins in a leaf, the currents of the ocean, the very structure of a cell, and the cosmic dance of planets.  
Here be yer first poster, me bucko, for all to ponder and admire\!
